FIELDS.NAME: Fresh Market Mart
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Fresh Market Mart operates as a full-service supermarket dedicated to providing a wide variety of high-quality fresh, frozen, and packaged food items. Our store spans over 3,000 square feet, allowing us to offer an extensive selection of groceries, including fresh produce, meats, dairy, bakery products, and pantry staples. We operate under strict compliance with all local and federal food safety regulations, ensuring that our employees receive regular training and that our facilities undergo consistent inspections to maintain food safety standards.

We prioritize maintaining a clean and organized shopping environment to enhance consumer safety and satisfaction. Our rigorous pest control and sanitation procedures further contribute to a hygienic shopping experience. Additionally, we have established relationships with reputable vendors who meet our stringent quality control requirements, ensuring that all products stocked in our store meet the highest standards. Our commitment to compliance includes having the necessary permits for any on-site food preparation, although we do not have on-site fuel sales, thus aligning with environmental safety regulations. Our operation is focused on providing quality products while ensuring a safe and welcoming atmosphere for all customers.

Our supermarket offers a range of products, including on-site fuel sales, allowing customers to conveniently refuel their vehicles while shopping for groceries.

FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Fresh Market Mart does not have any operations involving the storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting of hazardous materials, as we do not have on-site fuel sales or fuel tanks. Our operations comply with all relevant environmental regulations.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Fresh Market Mart does not sponsor athletic teams as part of its community engagement strategy. The focus is primarily on providing quality products and services to customers.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The compliance officer checks the certificates to ensure coverage is in place.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Fresh Market Mart has not had any applicants indicted or convicted of fraud, bribery, arson, or any arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. We maintain a strict compliance program to ensure operational integrity and safety.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Fresh Market Mart has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the past three years. We are committed to compliance and maintaining our operational standards.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Fresh Market Mart does not lease employees to or from other employers. Our staffing is managed internally to ensure compliance with operational standards and employee training protocols.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – Fresh Market Mart does not currently carry Workers Compensation insurance, as it is not compliant with the necessary regulations for coverage.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Fresh Market Mart does not own or operate any other business. Our operations are focused solely on our full-service supermarket.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Fresh Market Mart does not have any other insurance policies with this company, as we currently do not hold any active policies aside from our rejected coverage due to compliance issues.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Fresh Market Mart is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products beyond incidental retail private label activities. Our operations focus solely on retailing a wide variety of grocery items without additional processing.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Fresh Market Mart does not rent or loan equipment to others, as this could introduce additional liability exposure and operational risks.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Fresh Market Mart has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. We maintain strong financial practices to ensure operational stability.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Fresh Market Mart does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as we do not conduct operations that involve such materials, ensuring compliance with safety and environmental regulations.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Fresh Market Mart does not have any catastrophe exposure as it operates without on-site fuel sales and maintains compliance with all relevant environmental regulations.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Fresh Market Mart has not experienced any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We prioritize compliance and safety within our operations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Fresh Market Mart has no uncorrected fire code violations and maintains compliance with all relevant safety regulations.
